WITH TPN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 AS QuoteNO, SQUOTED.SQDLIN_0 AS QuoteLine, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 AS QuoteDate, SQUOTED.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SQUOTED.QTY_0 AS QTY, SQUOTED.STU_0 AS Unit, SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SQUOTE.CUR_0 AS Currency, SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, ISNULL (CONVERT(VARCHAR, SORDER.ORDDAT_0, 120), '') AS OrderDate, SQUOTED.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SQUOTED SQUOTED ON TPN.PN = SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SQUOTE SQUOTE ON SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 = SQUOTE.SQHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 AND SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 != '' INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SQUOTED.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SQUOTED.BPCORD_0 WHERE SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 DESC, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH TPN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.STU_0 AS Unit, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON TPN.PN = SORDERP.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SORDER.BPCORD_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH TPN AS ( ), T00 AS ( -- The closed sales order SELECT SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectQty, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, COMPANY.ACCCUR_0 AS Currency FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON TPN.PN = SORDERP.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 = 3 -- Important, only closed sales order
ORDER BY OrderDate DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY ), T01 AS ( -- The provide projectNO and Qty for closed sales order SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, SPACKD.LOT_0 AS ProvideProjectNO, COUNT(SPACKD.SERNUM_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO, SPACKD.LOT_0 ) AS ProvideQty FROM T00 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 = T00.OrderNO AND SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 = T00.OrderLine INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SPACKD SPACKD ON SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = SPACKD.VCRNUM_0 AND SDELIVERYD.SDDLIN_0 = SPACKD.VCRLIN_0 AND LEN (SPACKD.LOT_0) > 5 -- To skip misc projectNO ), T02 AS ( -- 只保留 JOIN 键 + ProvideTotalQty, 去掉 OrderDate/ProjectNO/OriProjectNO SELECT DISTINCT T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO, SUM(PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) AS ProvideTotalQty FROM T01 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 -- no site limit, for hongkong project, purchase by zhuhai INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AND ( PORDERP.ITMREF_0 = OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 -- PN same to sales order OR CHARINDEX (OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0) > 0 ) -- PNOG, SMEC, ITMDES1 maybe contains version INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ), T03 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.PN, T00.OrderDate, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, T00.ProjectNO, T00.OriProjectNO, T00.Currency, ( SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(T00.ProjectQty, 0) AS Cost, ( SUM( PORDERQ.LINATI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0)) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(T00.ProjectQty, 0) AS CostWithTax FROM T00 INNER JOIN T01 ON T00.OrderNO = T01.OrderNO AND T00.OrderLine = T01.OrderLine INNER JOIN T02 ON T02.OrderSite = T01.OrderSite AND T02.ProvideProjectNO = T01.ProvideProjectNO INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ) SELECT * FROM T03 ORDER BY OrderDate DESC

WITH TPN AS ( ), T00 AS ( -- The closed sales order SELECT SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON TPN.PN = SORDERP.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 = 3 -- Important, only closed sales order
ORDER BY OrderDate DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY ), T01 AS ( -- The delivered projectNO maybe from other project / stock project -- 只留 JOIN 键 + ProvideQty；ProjectNO 仅用于窗口分区，不输出；ProjectQty 全程未用，删除 SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, SPACKD.LOT_0 AS ProvideProjectNO, COUNT(SPACKD.SERNUM_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO, SPACKD.LOT_0 ) AS ProvideQty FROM T00 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 = T00.OrderNO AND SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 = T00.OrderLine INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SPACKD SPACKD ON SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = SPACKD.VCRNUM_0 AND SDELIVERYD.SDDLIN_0 = SPACKD.VCRLIN_0 AND LEN (SPACKD.LOT_0) > 5 -- To skip misc projectNO ), T02 AS ( -- Get main parts Qty purchased for each ProvideProjectNO -- 只留 JOIN 键 + ProvideTotalQty SELECT DISTINCT T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO, SUM(PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) AS ProvideTotalQty FROM T01 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 -- no site limit, for hongkong project, purchase by zhuhai INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AND ( PORDERP.ITMREF_0 = OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 -- PN same to sales order OR CHARINDEX (OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0) > 0 ) -- ITMDES1 maybe contains version INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ), T03 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.PN, T00.OrderDate, T00.ProjectNO, T00.OriProjectNO, T01.ProvideProjectNO, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PurchasePN, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 AS Description, PORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS PurchaseQty, PORDERQ.STU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS LineCurrency, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS Netprice, PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 AS LineAmount, PORDERQ.LINATI_0 AS LineAmountWithTax, -- total for provide projectNO --SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER (PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO) AS ProvideAmount, --SUM(PORDERQ.LINATI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0))) OVER (PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO) AS ProvideAmountWithTax, -- total for the sales projectNO PORDERQ.CPRCUR_0 AS Currency, ( SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) AS ProvideCost, ( SUM( PORDERQ.LINATI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0)) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) AS ProvideCostWithTax FROM T00 INNER JOIN T01 ON T00.OrderNO = T01.OrderNO AND T00.OrderLine = T01.OrderLine INNER JOIN T02 ON T02.OrderSite = T01.OrderSite AND T02.ProvideProjectNO = T01.ProvideProjectNO INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 = PORDER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ) SELECT * FROM T03 ORDER BY OrderSite DESC, OrderDate DESC, ProjectNO DESC, ProvideCostWithTax DESC -- Let the biggest cost be the first line

WITH TPN AS ( ) SELECT SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.STU_0 AS Unit, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 AS ShipDate, DateDiff (day, SORDER.ORDDAT_0, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0) AS Duration FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.ITMREF_0 = TPN.PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SORDER.BPCORD_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
